in_sanskrit.name: हनिषा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The Sanskrit name Hanisha is derived from the Sanskrit word हनिष (hanisha), which means 'bringer of happiness'. The name is formed by adding the suffix आ (aa) to the root word, which denotes the feminine gender.

in_hindi.name: हानिशा
in_hindi.long_meaning: The Hindi name Hanisha is the same as the Sanskrit name, as they share the same origin and meaning.

in_tamil.name: ஹானிஷா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name Hanisha is derived from the Tamil word ஆனந்தம் (aanandam), which means 'joy'. The name Hanisha in Tamil is formed by adding the suffix ாளர் (aalar) to the root word, which denotes the feminine gender and the meaning 'bringer'.

in_telugu.name: హానిషా
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name Hanisha is derived from the Telugu word ఆశీర్భవేది (aasirbhavedi), which means 'bringer of prosperity'. The name Hanisha in Telugu is formed by adding the suffix శా (shaa) to the root word, which denotes the feminine gender.

in_marathi.name: Hanisha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of prosperity and happiness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hanisha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hanisha is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'hanishka' which means 'Goddess of prosperity and happiness'. In Hindu mythology, Hanisha is an aspect of the Goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth and prosperity. She is often depicted holding a lotus flower and a pot of gold coins, symbolizing abundance and material wealth.
